frame.replay: cold from 2004, a week at a time: every game of a week projected before any of it is absorbed; the market never enters a projection
frame.caveat: The engines’ linear weights and residual tables were fitted through 2025: on 2014–2025 they are partly in-sample (the replay rebuilds team state, not weights), which favours the ENGINE candidate. The 2026 season is out of sample for everything.

rules.score: mean multinomial log loss over win / push / lose events anchored on the engine’s own rounded number
rules.selection: lowest selection-window log loss; the incumbent ENGINE is kept unless beaten by at least 0.001 nats
rules.note: Written into the tool before any score was read. Confirmation and live windows are reported, never used to choose.
